annotations.title: SaaS metrics calculator (NRR, churn, LTV:CAC, magic number)

description: SaaS metrics calculator (NRR, churn, LTV:CAC, magic number) — SaaS / subscription health from one period of MRR movements: mrr_start, new_mrr, expansion_mrr, contraction_mrr, churned_mrr (optional: mrr end, customers_start, new_customers, lost_customers, sm_spend, gross_margin %, growth % YoY, profit_margin %, net_burn, period=month|quarter). Returns ARR, ARPA, growth (monthly + annualized), gross/net revenue retention, gross MRR + logo churn, quick ratio, customer lifetime, LTV, CAC, LTV:CAC, CAC payback months, magic number, burn multiple, Rule of 40, GOOD/OK/WEAK benchmark per metric, flags and a verdict STRONG/HEALTHY/MIXED/UNHEALTHY. Offline, instant. Price: $0.003 USDC (Base, via x402).
name: finance_saas_metrics
